text:
ravi: low-key poll: sunrise birdwatch + potluck on sunday morning or boardgame night saturday? both sound great but my apartment is a bit small for a massive meeple pile.

emi: birdwatch! been meaning to try the new binoculars i got. what time for sunrise?

ravi: aim for 6:00am meet at north pier lookout. quick 60-90 minute walk, then potluck brunch at my place ~9:30. bring something shareable.

claire: saturday games is tempting though. i have a new cooperative game i want people to try (2-6 players).

ben: i can do both but prefer the birdwalk. also happy to bring bagels for brunch. :bagel: any dietary constraints?

nora: i'm allergic to shellfish, so no shrimp trays for me please. otherwise i'm flexible.

emi: @ben thanks — could you bring at least one vegetarian option? i'll bring coffee and my french press.

ravi: noted. i'll label containers. small ask: no shoes in the apartment and wash hands before touching communal games or food.

claire: fair. also if we do games saturday, can folks bring snacks that aren't greasy? sticky game pieces are sad.

ops-bot: quick reminder: rooftop and shared-space events need "community events" registration. RSVP link: https://intranet/events. Also please follow food-allergy guidelines in the handbook.

ben: if anyone needs a ride to the pier sunday morning i have room for two. can pick up around 5:15 from central stop.

nora: @ben that would be amazing, thank you. can chip in for gas.

emi: question — what birds are we hoping to see? i'm a newbie but excited to try IDing gull subspecies.

ravi: common goals: terns, herons, and maybe some early migrating warblers. will have a basic checklist and a spare field guide.

claire: tiny poll idea: "Which do you prefer?" options: "Sunrise birdwalk + potluck", "Saturday boardgame night", "Both". @ops-bot can you spin that up?

ops-bot: Poll created: "Which do you prefer?" Options: "Sunrise birdwalk + potluck", "Saturday boardgame night", "Both". Voting open for 6 hours.

ben: voted Sunrise birdwalk + potluck.

emi: voted Sunrise birdwalk + potluck.

claire: voted Both.

ravi: looks like birdwalk is winning early. final call after poll closes. if turnout for the walk is low we'll pivot to a slow brunch + game demos at my place instead.

nora: either works for me. i'll bring a little blueberry loaf and my tiny ceramic mugs. see you all! :deciduous_tree:
